standard-dialogue-without-wearing-a-m-sp.npc: Ukkuk oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka gonk.

standard-dialogue-whilst-wearing-a-m-spe.npc: Who's an ugly human? Give me a banana!
Stupid human! Give monkey a banana!

standard-dialogue-whilst-wearing-a-m-spe.text: If the player doesn't have a banana in their inventory:

steps.player: Sorry monkey, I don't have any bananas.

steps.npc: Aghhh. You're a rubbish human, get monkey a banana now.

standard-dialogue-whilst-wearing-a-m-spe.text: If the player has a banana in their inventory:

steps.npc: Ha ha! Smelly human gave monkey a banana.

steps.player: Wow you're one nasty piece of work. Have you ever heard of gratitude?

steps.npc: Hey baldy, give monkey another banana!

steps.player: Just because I'm not covered in fur doesn't make me bald, you cheeky monkey.

steps.npc: Monkey wants another banana now! Give me, give me!

steps.player: Look I've had it with you, you little degenerate.
I'll not give you a banana until you learn manners.
